name: qualizeal
description: QualiZeal's Claude Code plugins for the AI CoE: the AI-DLC Studio and its console.

plugins.name: qz-aidlc
plugins.description: QualiZeal AI-DLC Studio: governed lanes for agentic AI work - architect, spec with fresh-eyes review, build, a vectorless RAG kit built live by stage, evaluate, test, audit, deliver, demo, bid, office decks, workbooks and mail for each reader, a full-stack developer agent and the Knowledge Fabric - with routing that fits the model and effort to the task and to what is left, a guard that reads every command on a line, per-turn undo, goal mode, a GitHub agent, publishing that saves locally first, an audit chain, run ledger and report cards.

plugins.name: qz-console
plugins.description: QualiZeal console: a live map beside the chat of the AI-DLC harness at work, with the run's lane, stage, token budget and which stations filled the context. Runs in Claude Code (terminal and the desktop Code tab).
